description.value: Kool Beans is a coffee and ice cream shop in Keremeos, a small town along the Similkameen Valley cycling corridor in the southern Okanagan. For touring cyclists passing through on the Crowsnest or connected routes, it offers a natural stop for cold treats and a coffee fix. Keremeos is known as the 'Fruit Stand Capital of Canada,' and a local ice cream and coffee spot fits right into the town's character.
